procedure_error_criteria.violation_condition: Medical tape is positioned on the burned skin.
procedure_error_criteria.compliance_condition: Medical tape is not directly attached to the burned skin.
procedure_error_criteria.applicability_condition: During tape application to secure gauze.
procedure_error_criteria.source_reference: Secure the gauze with medical tape, keeping the tape off the burned skin

review_notes: A1, A3, A5, A6, A11 require manual completion as no reliable end-state image can be defined.
A2: gloves are worn on the hands. Omitted clean.
A4: old dressing is no longer covering the burn. Omitted gently.
A7: visible applied layer is present on the burn. Omitted cotton swab, thin, ointment identity.
A8: non-stick pad covers the burn. Omitted non-stick.
A9: gauze roll is wrapped around the burn. Omitted loosely.
A10: medical tape is positioned on the gauze. Omitted medical tape identity. Burned skin contact is checked in procedure_error_criteria.
